_about: Public-domain Louis Gaston de Ségur (1820-1881, Monseigneur, French apologist) in English for the Word Hoard: 8 books from Internet Archive scans, among them Plain Talk about the Protestantism of To-day (1868), The Freemasons (1869), Familiar Instructions (2 vols, 1878-1881), Short and Familiar Answers to Objections against Religion (1880) and On Holy Communion (1912). Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
